name: Page demo
description: The smallest complete plugin page, and the only example that asks for no permissions at all. It adds one link to every film and series, opening a page that shows exactly what the host handed the plugin. It is also the reference for per-profile settings and for both kinds of action button. Install it to see what a plugin page is made of; copy the awards example to build something real.
author: Multipass

settings.label: How much detail
settings.help: Yours alone. Your housemates each pick their own, and the page is cached per person because of it.

actions.label: Test the plugin
actions.help: Owner only. Proves the plugin answers.

actions.help: Yours. Says which version of the page you get.
